application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
description:
TPO100/1971 T1 Ash = NON TPO, T2 NON TPO, T3 = Horse chestnut T7, T4 = Sweet chestnut T8, T5 = T10 horse chestnut, T6,T7 NON TPO.
T1 - Common Ash (Fraxinus excelsior), 15m high and 16m wide, the tree is located and encroaching two properties. We would like to do an holistic crown reduction of 3m (back to previous pruning points) leaving 12m high and 13m wide. T2 - Purple leaved plum (Prunus cerasifera), 8m high and 7m wide, the tree has a low crown overhanging the footpath and Road and is also growing against street furniture, we would like to do an holistic crown reduction of 2m leaving 6m high and 5m wide also ensuring 2.5m clearance over the footpath and 1m clearance from street furniture. T3 - Horse Chestnut (Aesculus hippocastanum) 18m high and 12m wide, the tree has a low crown overhanging the footpath and Road and is also growing close to the building, we would like to crown lift 5m over the road and 2.5m over footpath and prune back to ensure 2m clearance from the building. T4 - Sweet chestnut (Castanea sativa) 18m high and 12m wide, the tree has a low crown over the road and footpath and is also growing close to the building, we would like to crown lift 5m over the road and 2.5m over the footpath and prune back to ensure 2m clearance from the building. T5 - Horse chestnut (Aesculus hippocastanum) 15m high and 14m wide, the tree is located next to the entrance for the building and starting to become a nuisance for high sided vehicles, also has a low crown overhanging the road and footpath, we would like to re-pollard at 8m from ground level (back to previous pruning points) leaving 8m high and 7m wide, this will ensure we have clearance over the footpath, entrance and road while keeping the tree balanced. T6 - Holm Oak (Quercus ilex) 7m high and 5m wide, this is a self seeded tree and the stem is growing against the neighbouring property, we would like to remove the tree to mitigate and future problems.
